# SarkariRadar

> An 8-question quiz that finds which Indian government schemes you are eligible for.

SarkariRadar matches you against 30 curated central government schemes and shows eligible and almost-eligible results, with what you get and how to apply.
It is for people in India checking scheme eligibility, with a Hindi and English toggle.

Built by Aditya Pratap: https://adityapratapjhansi.vercel.app/about.html
